Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Overclocks neuroport-monowire connections, allowing simultaneous uploading of quickhacks as the target is affected by the monowire.

Monowire Cyberware Enhancement. This enhancement does not count toward the amount of Cyberware Enhancements installed into the Monowire. With an Action and 4 hours, the user can load one Quickhack of Standard Difficulty (DV8) or lower into the Monowire, or swap out a loaded Quickhack for another. While this Quickhack is loaded, it is unusable as a Quickhack when netrunning normally.

While Combat Software (Data Tunnelling) is installed, once per combat encounter, the user can sacrifice their Move Action to charge Data Tunnelling. Their next Action must be a ROF 1 Attack using Data Tunnelling, or else the charge is lost. When using Data Tunnelling, if the attack hits, it deals 1d6 additional damage (3d6). This also counts as the user Jacking In Directly to the target's Neuroport and (if they’re a Netrunner) provides one free Net Action that can only be used in that Turn. This Net Action can be anything, but only the Quickhack loaded into the Monowire is available for Quickhacking.

Enhances: Monowire
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's required content includes the Edgerunners Mission Kit and Interface RED, and this parent piece comes from there rather than from Cyberpunk RED - Core, which ships no item for it. Make the parent yourself before installing this into it.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
